decision.explanation: The question asks for the construction date of 'the Kansas City Southern Depot'. The provided sources identify three distinct depots with this name located in different cities, each with a specific construction date: 1) The depot in Zwolle, Louisiana, was built in 1914 (Source D1S2). 2) The depot in Many, Louisiana, was built in 1929 (Source D3S2, D5S3). 3) The depot in DeQuincy, Louisiana, was built in 1923 (Source D6S4). Since these are distinct entities (different locations) sharing the same generic name, all three dates are valid, complementary answers to the unqualified question.
